items.Sentence: The treatment and storage facilities consist of headworks, a flow diverter, aerated treatment Ponds 1 and 2 operated in series, an aerated treatment Pond 4, an effluent storage Pond 6 and the LAA.
The effluent from Pond 2 is conveyed to Pond 4, which functions as a settling/polishing pond. A 5-horsepower aerator was installed in Pond 4 to provide mixing and aeration.

From Pond 4, wastewater is conveyed to a disinfection facility where wastewater is disinfected with sodium hypochlorite at 12 mg/L to meet the WDRs effluent coliform limitations prior to being discharged to Pond 6.
Pond 6 is an unlined storage reservoir of secondary treated wastewater.
The Discharger stopped using the pond for storage on a regular basis, but uses it on an emergency basis during wet years (e.g., winter of 2005/2006).
Prior to the year 2003, the Discharger used Pond 5 as an effluent storage pond.
The tertiary treatment includes microfloc, coagulation-flocculation, two stage filtration and UV disinfection.
